Title: a question : what are all the V:TES promo cards?

Messages.Author: Cheesecake
Messages.Body:
Some promo cards were released in Scrye and Inquest magazine.
Are they common? Will they be included in Sabbat War starters?
Or are they exclusive promo cards not available anywhere else?

What are all the promo cards printed so far and how can I get them all?

Badly need promo cards.

Messages.Author: tr0i...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <gdN_5.1124$n3.2...@news.globetrotter.net>,


There are 4 promo cards.
Lucita and Sascha Vykos are available in the Sabbat War Lasombra and
Tzimsice starters respectively.

Mariana Gilbert and Dan Murdock are the others. You can basically find
them at any sanctioned V:TES tournament or demo.

Don't be fooled. These promo cards are not difficult to obtain. I
haven't been playing for long at all, and I already have more than 1
copy of each.

Cantila is right here - in Europe, those two promo cards are comparable to
two-headed cows (well, yes, I DO exaggerate here, but let's say almost,
ok?).
I was more than happy when I obtained 3 (three, my God!) Marianas and a
handful of Dans last year in a trade (from Sorrow) - it gave me a way to mak
e my playgroup happy way before christmas by giving some of those cards away
as presents.

Last time this subject about those two promo vamps popped up on this
newsgroup, LSJ stated that you could just send a SASE to Wizards of the
Coast to get one copy of each for free - as I pointed out in that thread, I
(and friends from my playgroup) had tried that before, and I did indeed try
it again after thatt thread (using IRCs, of course), only to find out that,
as before, WotC obviously did not seem to like being bothered by such
requests when they came from overseas. Sad, but true.

So the question is:
Now that White Wolf has re-acquired the rights to V:tES, what possibilities
do we Europeans have do get those cards?
